changes: Row, column and aggregate task scans iterate row windows lazily instead of constructing whole-file prefix and window arrays.
Only the current window descriptor is admitted, and it releases when iteration advances, closes or fails.
Retain the array-returning helper as a compatibility wrapper for direct callers.

For backward traversal after at least a full metadata pass, build an admitted Float64 prefix index only when it fits within half available capacity and leaves room for the window descriptor. Otherwise continue rescanning.

validation.structural_test: 1000 ordered disjoint windows read exactly 1000 metadata counts and retain constant descriptor reservations; first next reads only one count.
edge_cases: backward and overlapping ranges preserve order
existing invalid-span tests and real task fixtures
validation.real_http_tests: 4 passed before adaptive-index follow-up; not rerun for this follow-up
validation.adaptive_index: Twenty descending ranges across 1000 groups: 19810 metadata reads under a 1 KiB pool, 2000 reads under a 64 KiB pool, identical output; both normal completion and early return release index and descriptor reservations.

contention_followup.scenario: Suspend after first window, reserve all but 1 KiB of shared headroom in a competing job, verify rescan fallback, release competing storage, verify later index admission. Force metadata failure during index construction and verify the next job can reserve the entire pool.
contention_followup.scope: Deterministic shared-pool interleaving; not a threaded scheduler or production-cloud stress test.

tradeoffs: Ordered disjoint ranges remain linear without an index. Backward/overlapping ranges use an index when measured work and available headroom justify it; low-headroom operation retains the rescan CPU cost.
The compatibility array helper still materializes its return value; scan execution uses the admitted iterator.
remaining: Task splitting/grouping topology, borrowed parser boundaries and other allocation-matrix gaps remain open.
No total-heap bound or cloud-latency improvement is claimed.
